I couldn't find this in the FastAPI docs. These documents cover FastAPI, not Flask, and they don't mention AWS Lambda.

The closest guidance is for FastAPI apps: You can deploy FastAPI apps to any cloud provider you choose.[1] Follow your cloud provider's guides to deploy FastAPI apps with them.[1]

For a Flask app, check the Flask documentation's deployment section and AWS's Lambda guides for Python web apps.
